filing.title: Luma Industrial Holdings 10-Q quarterly report
filing.bodyText:
FORM 10-Q
Luma Industrial Holdings (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)
For the quarterly period ended March 31, 2026
Trading Symbol(s) LUMA New York Stock Exchange
Capital Allocation
The board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share, payable on June 30, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on June 15, 2026. The board also authorized a share repurchase program of up to $250.0 million. Revenue was $410.0 million for the quarter compared to $398.0 million in the prior-year quarter.
